resolution.plan: [TEST MESSAGE] is filled with each of the 2,264 sentences of the Financial PhraseBank 100%-agreement subset (Table 2 counts 570/303/1,391 match FPB's Sentences_AllAgree file exactly). The naive prompt is the single-LLM template printed in Sec. 2.2 ('[TEST MESSAGE] Question: what is the sentiment? Answer with negative/neutral/positive.'); run gpt-4o-2024-05-13 at temperature 0, map the answer to the three classes and compare accuracy/F1 with Table 4 (74.57 / 77.99).
